probes.name: formula_tree_gate_counts
probes.lean_source:
import DiophantineConsistency.NativeZFC
open DiophantineConsistency
open NativeFormulaSyntax
private def a : NatExpr (Fin 4) := .var 0
private def b : NatExpr (Fin 4) := .var 1
private def c : NatExpr (Fin 4) := .var 2
private def u : NatExpr (Fin 4) := .var 3
#eval [QuarticCompiler.Gates.count (row1 a b),
  QuarticCompiler.Gates.count (row2 a b c),
  QuarticCompiler.Gates.count (row3 a b c),
  QuarticCompiler.Gates.count (row4 a b c),
  QuarticCompiler.Gates.count (row5 a b c),
  QuarticCompiler.Gates.count (row6 a b),
  QuarticCompiler.Gates.count (growth a b c),
  QuarticCompiler.Gates.count (row8 a b c u),
  QuarticCompiler.Gates.count (bundle a b c)]

known_checked_local_count.measure: one-step graph witnesses before trace and quartic flattening
